page_note: This page is dominated by Manichaean ecclesial material discussing the catechumen institution: fasting, prayer, almsgiving to the holy ones, the 'step of the catechumenate' (ⲃⲁⲑⲙⲟⲥ ⲛ̄ⲧⲙⲛⲧⲕⲁⲧⲏⲭⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ), and the power of the catechumen to release works through ritual practice. Page-level teaching purity is 0.000. However, embedded in this ecclesial discussion is a stretch of genuine cosmological substrate language (segs 14-17) describing the release of light particles 'out of every place where they dwell within, while bound, while mingled' from heaven, earth, trees, and flesh, going 'up to the Height' (ⲁⲡⲧⲭⲓⲥⲉ). This is the substrate cosmology of light-release applied editorially to catechumen 'works.' The page closes with a parable frame (man going to city with his comitatus) — hortatory illustration. Editorial fatigue score is reversed (front-loaded ecclesial), but the entire page is primarily institutional.
